31487-(R1862).s: The bill adds a second paragraph to article 38 of the Military Criminal Code so that a soldier who uses force within the lawful performance of duties and in accordance with the rules set for that duty is not punishable. It also broadens the definition of war in article 71 to cover armed conflict involving the Kingdom for individual or collective self-defence or restoring international peace and security.
31487-(R1862).j: The memorandum justifies the provision by pointing to the Commissie-Borghouts recommendation for a specific statutory basis for the criminal exemption of use-of-force instructions, and to the changed international role of the armed forces.
q: Provided that international humanitarian law is not violated and the soldier has not exceeded the limits of his authority.
Daarbij gelden wel de voorwaarden dat het internationaal humanitair recht niet wordt geschonden en de militair de grenzen van zijn bevoegdheid niet heeft overschreden.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (art. 38, lid 2 WMSr)
rules set for the performance of the soldier's duty (use-of-force instructions)
p: Artikel I, onderdeel A (art. 38, lid 2 WMSr)
Makes a soldier's use of force non-punishable when it follows rules of engagement set by the executive, linking criminal exemption to executive instructions rather than statute.

parties: The CDA supports the bill but stresses that the use-of-force instructions and judicial assessment of proportionality and subsidiarity must govern whether force was legitimate.

A judge will also, when assessing whether force was legitimately used in individual situations, mainly focus on these use-of-force instructions, taking into account an assessment of subsidiarity and proportionality.

Ook een rechter zal zich bij de beoordeling of in individuele situaties gelegitimeerd geweld is toegepast immers vooral richten op deze geweldsinstructies, met in acht name van een beoordeling van subsidiariteit en proportionaliteit.
The SP warns against false security for soldiers, insists that use of force must remain controllable, and asks whether the other Borghouts recommendations have been implemented.
The use of force must always remain controllable.
Gebruik van geweld zal altijd controleerbaar moeten zijn.

The PvdA asks for a uniform definition of lawful use of force, clarity on rules of engagement and national reservations, and whether a Quick Reaction Team review should be subject to a rechter-commissaris.

Does the government share the PvdA view that, after a Quick Reaction Team has investigated an incident and presented its findings, it should be for a rechter-commissaris to assess whether article 38(2) WMSr applies in the case?

Deelt de regering met betrekking tot bovenstaande de opvatting van de leden van de fractie van de PvdA dat het wenselijk zou zijn indien, nadat het zogenoemd «Quick Reaction Team» na een incident een onderzoek heeft ingesteld en haar bevindingen gepresenteerd heeft, het vervolgens aan een rechter-commissaris zou moeten zijn te beoordelen of er in casu sprake is geweest van een situatie waarbij artikel 38 lid 2 WMSr van toepassing is?

31700-XVII.s: This bill formally establishes the 2009 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the ministry of Youth and Family, setting expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros with effect from 1 January 2009. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes policy goals on youth care, child protection, family support and alcohol prevention, but the bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Article 1 The budget statement belonging to this act for the budget of Youth and Family (XVII) for the year 2009 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van de begroting van Jeugd en Gezin (XVII) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31965-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) to reflect the Spring Memorandum, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force of the amendment as of 1 June 2009.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc. To all who shall see or hear read these, greetings!
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz. Allen die deze zullen zien of horen lezen, saluut!

32123-XVII.s: The bill formally establishes the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the ministry of Youth and Family, in thousands of euros, with the budget totals for the policy articles. It also grants a derogation from Comptabiliteitswet 2001 articles 5 and 14 so that the explanatory notes present budget information at the level of the main policy priorities, as part of a departmental experiment evaluated in 2010.
32123-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the derogation from budget presentation rules as a time-limited experiment to improve political accountability, to be evaluated in 2010.
q: The experiment will be evaluated in 2010.
Het experiment zal worden geëvalueerd in 2010.

32222-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Ministry of Youth and Family (Jeugd en Gezin) following the autumn budget memorandum, adjusting obligations, expenditure and revenue across policy articles on family and income, healthy growing up, and care and protection. The explanatory memorandum notes that certain commitments are drawn from the VWS subsidy scheme and lists institutions receiving funds for youth care and secure youth care.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Youth and Family budget for 2009 (amendment linked to the autumn budget memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de begroting voor Jeugd en Gezin (XVII) voor het jaar 2009 (wijziging samenhangende met de Najaarsnota)

32500-A.s: This bill formally adopts the 2011 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Infrastructuurfonds), setting expenditure, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros, effective from 1 January 2011. The explanatory memorandum excerpts describe project management, pilot programmes and the coastguard budget, without creating delegated rule-making power.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2011 attached to this law is hereby adopted.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32609-XIV.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (LNV) as a one-off supplementary budget linked to the departmental reorganisation, and transfers LNV's budget to the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation. It exempts LNV's 2011 budget from the annual report and closing balance requirements of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
32609-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the exemption by the reorganisation, with budget transfers to the new ministry and audit checks by the Auditdiensten and Algemene Rekenkamer.
q: Notwithstanding Article 51(2) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, no annual report and no closing balance will be prepared by the responsible minister for the LNV budget for 2011.

In afwijking van artikel 51, tweede lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt met betrekking tot de begroting van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het jaar 2011 door Onze betrokken Minister geen jaarverslag en geen saldibalans opgemaakt.
p: Article 4 dispenses with the annual report and closing balance for LNV's 2011 budget, reducing the accountability information available to parliament for that year, though the Auditdiensten and Algemene Rekenkamer retain audit access.

32609-XVI.s: The bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, an incidental supplementary budget linked to departmental reorganisation. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force from 2 January 2011, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2011 is amended.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd.

32780-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, making adjustments in expenditure and commitments across policy articles following the spring memorandum. It contains no new delegations of rule-making power and no changes to executive oversight or citizens' legal protection.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2011.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2011.

33183-(R1975).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the Treaty of Brussels of 9 December 2011 on the accession of the Republic of Croatia to the European Union, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It also exempts from parliamentary approval treaties that are necessary and direct consequences of that accession treaty.
33183-(R1975).j: The memorandum justifies the exemption from parliamentary approval for accession-related treaties as a necessary and direct consequence of the approved treaty, without a separate delegation of rule-making power.
q: Approval by the States General of the treaties concluded as a necessary and direct consequence of the Treaty referred to in Article 1, between EU member states or with third states or international organisations, is not required.

De goedkeuring door de Staten-Generaal van de verdragen, welke als noodzakelijk en rechtstreeks gevolg van het in artikel 1 genoemde Verdrag gesloten worden tussen de lidstaten van de Europese Unie onderling, danwel tussen de lidstaten, al dan niet gezamenlijk met de Europese Unie enerzijds en derde staten of internationale organisaties anderzijds, is niet vereist.

parties: Asks whether Croatia has a durable track record on minority protection, corruption and judicial independence, and what safeguards (emergency brake) the government will use.
In Croatia's case it is still possible to pull the emergency brake if the country does not meet the set requirements.
In het geval van Kroatië is het nog mogelijk aan de noodrem te trekken wanneer het land niet voldoet aan de gestelde eisen.
Supports strict monitoring of rule-of-law reforms and asks what conditions would justify postponing accession and how Croatia's track record on chapter 23 is judged.
The PvdA members see the need and the advantages of strict monitoring.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zien de noodzaak en de voordelen van een strikte monitoring.
Opposes enlargement and argues Croatia does not meet the Copenhagen criteria, corruption is high, and minority rights are insufficiently protected, urging the government to brake.
Currently the Copenhagen criteria are not being met.
Er wordt momenteel niet voldaan aan de Kopenhagencriteria.
Broadly approves but asks about monitoring results, the rule-of-law and fundamental-rights scores, anti-corruption laws and whether safeguard clauses will be used.
Has the government already taken a position on whether it will use the general safeguard clause and the two specific safeguard clauses?
Heeft de regering al een positie ingenomen ten aanzien van de vraag of zij gebruik zal maken van de algemene vrijwaringclausule en de twee specifieke vrijwaringclausules?

Finds it uncomfortable to ratify while durability of rule-of-law measures is still unproven; considers postponing ratification after the next report and asks how effective crime-fighting will be verified.
If the Commission's first report disappoints them, they are considering arguing for suspending ratification until after the next report.
Indien de eerste rapportage van de Europese Commissie hen teleurstelt overwegen zij om ervoor te pleiten de ratificatie op te schorten tot na de volgende rapportage.
Supports the monitoring of readiness, especially six-monthly reports on the judiciary, fundamental freedoms and justice, and asks about the 'emergency stop' procedure.
They look forward to the reports, including the separate six-monthly reports on the judiciary, fundamental freedoms and justice and security.
Zij kijken uit naar de rapportages, waaronder de separate, zesmaandelijkse rapportages over de rechterlijke macht, fundamentele vrijheden en justitie en veiligheid.
Supports enlargement conditional on full Copenhagen compliance and asks whether monitoring covers minority and LGBT protection, and whether the public is informed.

33400-A.s: The bill sets the 2013 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Infrastructuurfonds), fixing expenditure and revenue by budget article in thousands of euros, and takes effect on 1 January 2013. The explanatory memorandum describes project-level budget adjustments, indexation, maintenance cuts and Coast Guard financing, without creating new executive powers.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2013 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

34085-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and its agencies, via the second supplementary budget tied to the Najaarsnota. It changes expenditure, commitments and revenue across policy articles such as curative care, social support, youth and sport, primarily through budget reallocations.
q: We ... have found good and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2014 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd

34200-B.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2014 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by adopting the supplementary budget statement, fixing commitment amounts for the general grant and special grants, and setting entry into force. It is a budgetary adjustment with no substantive delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
34200-B.j: The memorandum justifies the budget difference by explaining that payments to municipalities may deviate from the budget while the distribution factor is not yet final, due to differences between estimated and applied allocation criteria.
q: The reason for the difference lies in the fact that as long as the distribution factor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to municipalities may deviate from what is stated in the budget.

De reden van het verschil ligt in het feit dat zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat.

34210-A.s: The bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund by adjusting obligations, expenditure and revenue across transport articles, with effect from 1 December of the budget year. It is a supplementary budget adjustment and does not delegate rule-making power or shift power away from checks.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

34300-A.s: This bill formally establishes the 2016 expenditure and revenue budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund at around EUR 5.78 billion, with the amounts set in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January 2016, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2016 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34485-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget statements for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, its agencies, and the Animal Health Fund, approving first supplementary budget changes in thousands of euros. It mainly adjusts appropriations, receipts and agency budgets, with explanatory notes on items such as UMTS licence receipts, gas revenue and reserves.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII)

34775-VIII.s: The bill fixes the 2018 state budget for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, including the budget statement for the agencies DUO and Nationaal Archief. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and provides entry into force on 1 January 2018.
q: The budget statement for the year 2018 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34845-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statements (departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, agency budgets, and the Animal Health Fund) for a second supplementary budget tied to the autumn budget review. The accompanying explanatory memorandum lists budget transfers, reserve movements and spending changes, without delegating rule-making powers.

34853-(R2096).s: The bill approves the Netherlands and Curaçao's accession to the 2016 Multilateral Instrument implementing tax treaty measures against base erosion and profit shifting (BEPS), and sets out which optional reservations are made on their behalf. It also states the entry into force date; the treaty measures themselves are described as binding on citizens, but no executive delegation is created by this law.
q: It is approved that, when the Kingdom is bound by the Convention referred to in Article 1, the reservations included in the following articles of the Convention are made for the Netherlands
Goedgekeurd wordt dat bij de binding van het Koninkrijk aan het in artikel 1 genoemde Verdrag voor Nederland de voorbehouden worden gemaakt die zijn opgenomen in de volgende artikelen van het Verdrag

parties: Asks about legal certainty, the principal purpose test's breadth, tiebreaker rules and dispute resolution, and wants safeguards against overbroad interpretation hurting genuine business.
What safeguards are provided to prevent the PPT being interpreted so broadly in the Netherlands or abroad that genuine business is affected?
Welke waarborgen zijn voorzien om te voorkomen dat men in Nederland of daarbuiten, de PPT dusdanig breed zal interpreteren dat het reële bedrijfsleven geraakt wordt?
Supports transparency and cooperation against profit shifting and asks mainly technical questions on offshore exclusions and reservations.
These members favour transparency, not least where differences in tax systems or treaties are concerned.
Deze leden zijn voorstander van transparantie, niet in de minste plaats wanneer het verschillen in belastingsystemen of -verdragen betreft.
Positive on the instrument but asks the government for motivation behind reservations and choices, and an impact analysis, especially on articles 4 and 12 before OECD consensus.
The CDA members ask the government to share this motivation with the House and take the opportunity to pose some specific questions about it.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering deze motivatie alsnog met de Kamer te delen en maken van de gelegenheid gebruik hierover ook nog enkele specifieke vragen te stellen.
Supports the convention and ambitious anti-avoidance aims, while asking how reservations, monitoring and the arbitration mechanism's binding nature will work.
These members support the government's ambitious approach to tackling tax avoidance and evasion.
Deze leden steunen de ambitieuze aanpak van de regering om belastingontwijking en -ontduiking aan te pakken.
Questions the flexibility allowing countries to choose measures, the confidential arbitration, cost-sharing burdening developing countries, and how effects are monitored.
How can it be prevented that countries tick precisely those measures that least get in their way?
Hoe kan worden voorkomen dat landen precies die maatregelen aanvinken die hen het minst in de weg zitten?

Concerned about withholding tax reductions harming developing countries, missing anti-abuse rules on management fees, and whether developing countries had real decision-making power; asks about notification of denied treaty benefits and arbitrator independence.
These members ask the government why no anti-abuse provision on management fees has been included in the tax treaties with Kenya and Malawi.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom er geen antimisbruikbepaling ten aanzien van management fees is opgenomen in de belastingverdragen met Kenia en Malawi.
Welcomes the convention as a milestone and supports participation in as many aspects as possible, asking about effectiveness given many countries' exceptions.
The PvdA members also support the aim of participating in as many aspects of the Convention as possible.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie steunen ook de inzet om aan zoveel mogelijk aspecten van het Verdrag deel te nemen.

35000-C.s: This bill fixes the 2019 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the provinciefonds, the fund that finances the provinces, setting obligation amounts for the general grant at EUR 2,199,901,000 and for integration and decentralisation grants at EUR 0 and EUR 207,658,000 respectively. It takes effect on 1 January 2019, or retroactively if published later.
q: The obligation amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is fixed for the 2019 grant year at EUR 2,199,901,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake de van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2019 vastgesteld op € 2.199.901.000.

35200-A.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund through a supplementary closing law (Slotwet), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across infrastructure articles. The explanatory memorandum says it contains only technical implementation, bookkeeping and audit-driven adjustments, with some mutations previously shared with parliament via letters.
35200-A.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as technical execution, bookkeeping and control-finding adjustments already communicated to parliament, rather than any new powers.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen

35210-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation through a first supplementary budget, changing commitments, expenditures and receipts across policy articles. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 June 2019, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2019
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII), voor het jaar 2019

35300-XVII.s: This bill establishes the 2020 budget statute (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (BHOS), setting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros for its policy articles. It takes effect on 1 January 2020 with retroactive effect if published later, and the explanatory memorandum sets out development priorities and performance indicators for the coming years.
q: The budget statute annexed to this law for the year 2020 is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 9 September 2019 that it had no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for the ministries, funds and Koninkrijksrelaties, and recommended submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport of 16 September 2019 notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

35570-XIV.s: This bill fixes the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the budget statements for the NVWA agency and the Animal Health Fund, and the financial amounts (in thousands of euros). It is a budget act that sets appropriations and entry into force, with the explanatory memorandum describing spending priorities, NVWA inspection measures and subsidy schemes.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2021 annexed to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued a blanco advice on the 2021 budget bill for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and the Animal Health Fund, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport confirms this and notes one non-blanco advice concerning the Ministry of Finance budget, which is addressed in an annex.

35570-XVI.s: This bill sets the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport budget for 2021, including departmental expenditure and receipts and the budget statements for the executive agencies CBG, CIBG and RIVM, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum covers budget items, policy performance, evaluations and agency figures, and does not itself delegate rule-making or shift powers.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2021 that accompanies this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering gave no remarks on the 2021 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport confirms no reply is needed on those bills and notes one non-blank advice on the Ministry of Finance budget, addressed in an annex.

35925-XIII.s: This bill sets the 2022 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and the 2022 budget statements for its baten-lastenagentschappen (Agentschap Telecom, DICTU, Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit, RVO.nl). It fixes budgeted obligations, expenditures and receipts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 January 2022 or the day after the Staatsblad is issued, retroactive to 1 January.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2022 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it has no remarks on the draft 2022 budget bill for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and recommends submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport reports that some budgets required amendments and refers to attached appendices.

35934-(R2158).s: The bill removes the sunset clause that would otherwise end the power to revoke Dutch nationality in the interest of national security on 1 March 2022, making the power permanent. It also drops CTIVD oversight of the power's effectiveness, adds a legal basis for processing sensitive and criminal personal data for revocation decisions, and repeals the 2017 amending act.
35934-(R2158).j: The memorandum justifies keeping the power by pointing to terrorism threats, the WODC evaluation, and motions requesting permanence, and says the CTIVD oversight is redundant given individual and political oversight.
q: This bill does not amount to any substantive change to the power.
Dit wetsvoorstel strekt niet tot enige inhoudelijke wijziging van de bevoegdheid.
p: Removes the CTIVD's authority to oversee the effectiveness and proportionality of the nationality revocation power, leaving judicial review of individual decisions as the main check.
Allows the Minister to process sensitive and criminal personal data when deciding on nationality revocation, limited to what is necessary for that decision.
Preserves indefinitely the executive's power to revoke nationality, removing the sunset date that would have ended it.

parties: Supports making the power permanent but asks how the bill relates to the WODC video-trial research and how persons were expelled to the Netherlands without residence rights.
These members are therefore positive about the bill to make this power permanent and have some further questions.
Deze leden zijn dan ook positief over het wetsvoorstel tot permanentmaking van deze bevoegdheid en hebben voorts nog enkele vragen.
Doubts effectiveness and proportionality; finds it inconsistent to create a new power while removing oversight, and questions the claimed national-security benefit.
These members, however, have serious doubts whether this bill contributes to that and fear it may even have a counterproductive effect.</evidence_en>
Deze leden hebben echter ernstige twijfels of dit wetsvoorstel daaraan bijdraagt en vrezen dat het zelfs een averechts effect kan hebben.
Sees added value in dropping the sunset clause given WODC findings of lawful use, but asks questions on data processing grounds under the GDPR.
These members therefore see added value in dropping the sunset clause as this bill provides.
Deze leden zien dan ook meerwaarde in het laten vervallen van de horizonbepaling zoals onderhavig wetsvoorstel regelt.
Warns of rule-of-law erosion; notes a court found unlawfulness in two cases, questions the reasoning on deterrence and the OM's objections, and asks about the CTIVD's omission.
These concerns have not been removed and have even been strengthened now that the government wants to permanently anchor the power to revoke nationality through administrative measures.
Deze zorgen zijn niet weggenomen en zelfs versterkt nu de regering de bevoegdheid om het Nederlanderschap in te trekken via bestuursrechtelijke maatregelen permanent wil verankeren.
Not convinced of need and necessity; insists CTIVD oversight of proportionality and efficiency must remain since parliament cannot substitute for it.

Given that it is now proposed that the original bill should become permanent, these members consider oversight of efficiency and proportionality of this far-reaching power of the Minister of Justice and Security to be all the more important.

Mede gezien het feit dat nu wordt voorgesteld dat het oorspronkelijke wetsvoorstel een permanent karakter zou moeten krijgen achten deze leden toezicht op de doelmatigheid en proportionaliteit op deze vergaande bevoegdheid van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid van nog groter belang.
Stresses need for balance with legal safeguards, prosecution in the Netherlands over revocation, and finds removal of CTIVD oversight of the revocation power incomprehensible.
These members find it incomprehensible that the CTIVD's power to oversee the application of the power to revoke nationality by the Minister of Justice and Security is being removed.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vinden het onbegrijpelijk dat de bevoegdheid van de CTIVD om toezicht te houden op de toepassing van de bevoegdheid tot intrekking van het Nederlanderschap door de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid wordt geschrapt.

Requests justification for dropping the sunset clause and for CTIVD oversight, raises Article 90 Constitution and treaty concerns about shifting risk abroad, and questions revoking nationality of minors.
These members note that the Council of State states that a substantive justification with sufficiently weighty arguments is currently lacking.
Deze leden constateren dat de Afdeling stelt dat een dragende motivering met voldoende zwaarwegende argumenten op dit moment ontbreekt.
Finds insufficient weighty arguments for permanence, notes lack of evidence of security benefit, and raises GDPR and oversight gaps.
These members, however, judge that there are insufficient weighty arguments to enshrine this measure permanently in law.
Deze leden oordelen echter dat er onvoldoende zwaarwegende argumenten zijn deze maatregel permanent in de wet op te nemen.
Asks whether revocation is prioritized for jihadist travelers, how dual nationality and EU citizenship are weighed, and about the automatic appeal and legal aid arrangements.
These members ask the government in how many of the known cases this appeal led to a different assessment.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering in hoeveel van de tot nu toe bekende gevallen dit beroep heeft geleid tot een andere afweging.
Calls revocation disproportionately severe, based on mere potential threat, and indirectly discriminatory against dual nationals from minority communities.
The member of the BIJ1 faction notes that revoking someone's nationality is such a far-reaching measure that it must not be based on a potential threat.
Het lid van de BIJ1-fractie merkt op dat het ontnemen van iemands nationaliteit is een dusdanig vergaande maatregel is die niet gebaseerd mag zijn op een potentiële dreiging.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against making the power to strip Dutch nationality from dual nationals who joined terrorist organisations abroad permanent, questioning its necessity and complementarity to criminal law, and raised objections on the GDPR basis for processing sensitive data and the removal of CTIVD oversight. The government's reply largely rejects the objections on necessity and oversight but adjusts the data-processing basis, limiting it to political, religious and health data and adding safeguards.
concerns: The Afdeling found insufficient weighty arguments for making the temporary nationality-revocation power permanent, given doubts about its effects and complementarity to new criminal law instruments; the government maintained necessity.

The Afdeling asked that the general-interest exception for processing special category data be substantiated and limited, for example to religious or belief data; the government limited the basis to political, religious, philosophical and health data and motivated it.
The Afdeling asked for specific safeguards for processing criminal and special category personal data; the government added a paragraph on how safeguards are given effect.

The Afdeling asked for the removal of the CTIVD's oversight task to be justified; the government maintained removal, arguing CTIVD oversight covers intelligence services and parliament controls the minister.

The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address the experience of the Caribbean countries with the power and the threat picture there; the government clarified the power applies across the Kingdom and added explanation.

35975-XV.s: This bill amends the departmental expenditure budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for 2021 through a second supplementary budget, in thousands of euros, effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 1 December 2021. It sets out budget mutations per policy article, such as reduced WGA scholarship experiment and unemployment spending, without delegating rule-making power.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for the year 2021
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid voor het jaar 2021

36100-A.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Slotwet), recording technical budget adjustments and realised amounts for the year. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
36100-A.j: The explanatory memorandum says only technical implementation, bookkeeping and control-finding changes are included, with exceptions previously shared with the Staten-Generaal via letters.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

36200-XVII.s: This bill sets the 2023 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), fixing commitments, expenditures and receipts in thousands of euros across five policy articles. It also enacts the budget's entry into force from 1 January 2023 and its publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The budget statement attached to this law for the year 2023 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the 2023 budget bill for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The accompanying nader rapport from the Minister of Finance only transmits the request for a few budget changes listed in annexes and does not respond to any advisory points.

36360-XIX.s: This bill is a Slotwet that changes the 2022 budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds (XIX) to record the final realised figures, with all differences from the estimates shown as zero. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds (XIX) for the year 2022 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifonds (XIX) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36470-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statements for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the Dutch Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority, and the Animal Health Fund, implementing a second supplementary budget. It changes appropriations in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality for 2023.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

36470-XVI.s: This second supplementary budget for 2023 of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport amends the departmental budget statement in thousands of euros, with effect from the day after publication and retroactively from 1 December 2023. The explanatory memorandum justifies the adjustments mainly as commitment increases for 2024 and lower-than-expected subsidy realisations, and it contains no delegations of rule-making power.
36470-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the commitment increases as necessary to implement ongoing policy in 2024 and to enter commitments on time.
q: The increase in commitments has no consequences for the estimated 2023 expenditure, but is necessary to also implement ongoing policy in 2024 and to enter a commitment for it in time.

De ophoging van de verplichtingen heeft geen consequenties voor de geraamde uitgaven 2023, maar is noodzakelijk om ook uitvoering te kunnen geven aan lopend beleid in 2024 en hiervoor tijdig een verplichting aan te kunnen gaan.

36560-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statements (Slotwet) for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, its agencies (including the NVWA), and the Animal Health Fund, reflecting supplementary budgets and realised figures. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and shifts no power between the executive and checks.
q: This act enters into force on the day after the date of publication of the Staatsblad in which it is placed and has retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year in question.
Deze wet treedt in werking met ingang van de dag na de datum van uitgifte van het Staatsblad waarin zij wordt geplaatst en werkt terug tot en met 31 december van het onderhavige begrotingsjaar.

36560-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) and the budget statement for its agencies, setting realised figures and slot differences in thousands of euros. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and is retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.

36688-(R2205).s: The bill seeks parliamentary approval for the Kingdom of the Netherlands' extradition treaty with Morocco, concluded at Rabat on 18 December 2023, and would make it binding for the whole Kingdom. The explanatory memorandum notes the treaty includes human-rights-related safeguards that let judges, the public prosecutor and the Minister of Justice and Security test individual extradition requests against fundamental rights.
36688-(R2205).j: The memorandum justifies the treaty as a means of combating serious and undermining crime with an international dimension, in line with the Kingdom's obligations under EVRM articles 2 and 5.
q: This should also be reflected in a correct and responsible use of the Kingdom's treaty-making power.
Dat behoort ook tot uitdrukking te komen in een juist en verantwoord gebruik van de verdragsluitende bevoegdheid van het Koninkrijk.

parties: Asks for data on extradition requests, mutual legal assistance, and recognition of Moroccan sentences, and whether early extradition could worsen DJI prison capacity shortages.

Notes that human rights practice in Morocco falls short and asks how respect for rights will be ensured and monitored in implementation; also raises whether individuals should derive rights from the treaty's absolute refusal grounds.
Can the government explain how it will ensure that human rights are also respected in implementation practice and how this will be monitored?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe zij ervoor gaat zorgen dat mensenrechten ook in de uitvoeringspraktijk gerespecteerd gaan worden en hoe dat gecontroleerd gaat worden?

Points out that the treaty's treatment of ne bis in idem for foreign judgments conflicts with the stricter Dutch Criminal Code rule and asks why the government chose a facultative ground contrary to national law.
These members note that this is inconsistent with the bill, since judgments of courts in third states fall under the facultative refusal ground.
Deze leden constateren dat dit niet strookt met het wetsvoorstel, nu uitspraken van rechters in derde staten onder de facultatieve weigeringsgrond vallen.
Argues the treaty's ne bis in idem wording should be aligned with the Dutch Criminal Code's stricter refusal grounds rather than differing only in text.
Is the government willing to reconsider seeking better alignment with the Criminal Code?
Is de regering bereid om te heroverwegen om een betere aansluiting te zoeken bij het Wetboek van Strafrecht?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the extradition treaty with Morocco should clarify how it avoids breaching ne bis in idem, since optional refusal grounds for third-state judgments diverge from the Uitleveringswet and Criminal Code, and that the explanatory memorandum should specify which provisions of article 9 are directly binding on individuals. The government replied that it accepts the advice, will clarify the ne bis in idem provision in the memorandum and remove the binding character of article 9(2), while holding that article 3(1) binds only the states.
concerns: The treaty's optional refusal grounds for third-state judgments do not fully match the mandatory ne bis in idem rules in the Uitleveringswet and Criminal Code, so the government should clarify how breaches are prevented; the government says the treaty prevails and the memorandum is clarified but maintains the difference is practically harmless.

It should be specified in the explanatory memorandum which provisions of article 9 are directly binding on individuals and whether article 3(1) is too; the government removed the binding character of article 9(2) and maintains article 3(1) binds only states.

36740-XIV.s: This Dutch bill (Slotwet) adjusts the 2024 budget statements for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the agencies under it, and the Animal Health Fund, correcting for supplementary budgets and realised figures. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: Just as We approve and resolve by this: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2024 is amended
Gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze: Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd

36740-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the budget statement for its agencies, recording the final (slotwet) figures for appropriations, spending and receipts. It does not delegate rule-making power, shift power away from checks, or contain sunset, evaluation or oversight provisions.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2024 is amended.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd.

36915-XIII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2026 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) and the budget for its agencies, adjusting spending, commitments and receipts by several hundred million euros. It also makes the changes effective from 1 June 2026 and sets out the budget flexibility and NGF project allocations behind the adjustments.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2026 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2026 wordt gewijzigd
